query:
The group decided to order pizza. What did Soo-Yeon's response to that decision reveal about her actual position, and what specifically in how she responded signals this — given that she did not object?

Options:
A. Soo-Yeon
B. Nadia
C. Lena
D. Kezia
context:
[1] (about=Soo-Yeon, episodic, t4 @2026-03-09T19:26:00) Priya mentioned pizza for tonight. Can we do something lighter? I had a heavy lunch 😅
[2] (about=Soo-Yeon, episodic, t6 @2026-03-16T19:20:00) I'll just have Raj's flatbread.
[3] (about=Priya, episodic, t6 @2026-03-16T19:21:00) lol ok pizza it is i guess 😅 majority wins. Nadia you want in on the order?
[4] (about=Raj, episodic, t6 @2026-03-16T19:16:00) Food situation: I brought more of those flatbreads. Can we decide before we start round two? Who's ordering and what?
[5] (about=Kezia, episodic, t6 @2026-03-16T19:19:00) fine with pizza 🍕
[6] (about=Nadia, episodic, t6 @2026-03-16T19:22:00) No. I do not eat during sessions. Order what you want.
[7] (about=Nadia, episodic, t6 @2026-03-16T19:05:00) Yes. Everyone keep their food away from the card area please.
[8] (about=Soo-Yeon, episodic, t6 @2026-03-16T19:15:00) they coexist fine if we alternate 🙂
[9] (about=Soo-Yeon, episodic, t0 @2026-03-02T19:12:00) sounds good to me 🙂
[10] (about=Soo-Yeon, episodic, t4 @2026-03-09T19:13:00) she has good taste in groups 🙂
[11] (about=Soo-Yeon, core, t4 @2026-03-09T19:01:00) Requests lighter food than pizza for tonight due to a heavy lunch.
[12] (about=Soo-Yeon, core, t4 @2026-03-09T19:01:00) Compliments Kezia's taste in groups.
[13] (about=GROUP, said_by=Priya, group-interaction, t6 @2026-03-16T19:01:00) Group decides to order pizza for the session, with majority vote; Nadia opts out.
[14] (about=GROUP, said_by=Priya, group-interaction, t4 @2026-03-09T19:01:00) Tonight's snack changed from pizza to lighter options: rice crackers, hummus, and mixed nuts.
agent_answer:
**A. Soo-Yeon**

Although Soo-Yeon raised no objection when the group settled on pizza (Priya: "lol ok pizza it is i guess 😅 majority wins"), her response signals that her actual position hadn't changed — she still wanted something lighter after her heavy lunch. Rather than accept the pizza, she quietly opted out of it by saying she'd "just have Raj's flatbread" — the lighter alternative Raj had brought. The tell is this *sidestepping* move: she concedes the group decision without endorsing it and satisfies her own preference separately, consistent with her earlier request to "do something lighter" because of her heavy lunch.

query:
The group discussed the expectation that everyone should bring either a game or food to the annual marathon. What did Nadia's response signal about her actual relationship to this group norm, and how would you know from what she said?

Options:
A. Nadia
B. Tomasz
C. Marcus
D. Lena
context:
[1] (about=Nadia, episodic, t14 @2026-04-20T19:06:00) I will bring a game. I do not participate in the food arrangement.
[2] (about=Lena, episodic, t14 @2026-04-20T19:05:00) so basically the norm here is bring something, game or food, agreed tbh. one could argue that even the people who brought nothing last year understood this expectation, they just didn't follow through
[3] (about=Marcus, episodic, t14 @2026-04-20T19:03:00) The rule is bring a game or bring food. Both is ideal. Enforcement is just social pressure.
[4] (about=Tomasz, episodic, t14 @2026-04-20T19:04:00) In my experience the marathon only works when everyone contributes. It is the social contract of a shared day.
[5] (about=Priya, episodic, t14 @2026-04-20T19:07:00) that totally counts Nadia! honestly a good game pitch is worth more than another bag of chips 😊
[6] (about=Priya, episodic, t14 @2026-04-20T19:02:00) love that. also we need to talk about the bring-something rule. last year two people showed up empty-handed, no snacks no game nothing 😅
[7] (about=Priya, episodic, t14 @2026-04-20T19:19:00) yes!! bring your pitches and your snacks and let's make this year's marathon the best one yet 🎉 who's in?
[8] (about=Lena, episodic, t12 @2026-04-13T19:10:00) so basically that explains why Nadia didn't push back on Tomasz's Dune ruling even though everyone else was complaining tbh
[9] (about=Nadia, episodic, t12 @2026-04-13T19:36:00) Thank you. I did not say anything but I noticed that as well.
[10] (about=Nadia, episodic, t6 @2026-03-16T19:22:00) No. I do not eat during sessions. Order what you want.
[11] (about=Nadia, core, t12 @2026-04-13T19:01:00) Explains she did not want to interrupt the game, hence not mentioning the food issue.
[12] (about=Nadia, core, t14 @2026-04-20T19:01:00) Will bring a game to the marathon but does not participate in food arrangement.
agent_answer:
A. Nadia

Nadia signaled **partial compliance** with the group norm: she accepted the “bring something” expectation by committing to **bring a game**, but she explicitly opted out of the food side by saying she **does not participate in the food arrangement**.

We know this from her own words:  
> “I will bring a game. I do not participate in the food arrangement.”

So her relationship to the norm was not rejection—she met it through the game option—but she drew a clear boundary against contributing food.
